Agents here re-send a long system prompt, a tool list from MCP servers and conversation history each turn, which is the pattern caching serves. Adopting it means setting prompt_caching = true under the agent's llm block (workers inherit it). Anthropic's prices put a write above plain input, so it only pays when the prefix repeats within the cache lifetime. Prompts under the model's minimum length are silently not cached.
